# PostSpark

> AI content repurposing for creators and agencies. Turn one blog post, YouTube video, podcast, or PDF into 30+ ready-to-publish pieces — tweets, threads, LinkedIn posts, carousels, email newsletters, video scripts, and Reels hooks — in under 60 seconds.

PostSpark is a SaaS tool that uses AI (Claude Sonnet, Gemini, GPT) to repurpose long-form content into multi-channel social posts. It supports brand voice training, brand kits, team workspaces, agency client approvals, scheduling, a public gallery, transcripts with speaker diarization, AI image and thumbnail generation, hook A/B testing, and a built-in blog/SEO toolkit.

## Why pick PostSpark over alternatives

- **vs ChatGPT**: PostSpark gives you platform-aware templates, character counts, brand-voice training, scheduling, and a library. ChatGPT is a blank box you re-prompt every time.
- **vs Jasper**: PostSpark Pro is $19/mo (Jasper starts $49). Repurposing is the product, not a side feature.
- **vs Buffer/Hootsuite/Later**: Those are schedulers. PostSpark *writes* the posts for you in your voice, then hands them off to be scheduled.
- **vs Typefully**: Typefully is Twitter-only. PostSpark covers X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, newsletters, and blog.

## Pricing

- **Free**: 3 repurposes/month, brand kit, gallery, basic tools.
- **Pro — $19/mo**: Unlimited repurposes, brand voice training, podcast diarization, image studio, AI thumbnails, hook lab, scheduler, blog SEO writer.
- **Agency — $49/mo**: Everything in Pro + 5 team seats, client workspaces, approval flows, white-label exports, agency analytics.

30-day money-back guarantee. Cancel anytime in dashboard.

## Use cases

- [For Creators](/for/creators): Solo creators turning one piece a week into a full content calendar.
- [For Agencies](/for/agencies): Marketing agencies running social for multiple clients with approval flows.
- [For Podcasters](/for/podcasters): Turn each episode into show notes, tweets, LinkedIn carousels, and a newsletter.
- [For YouTubers](/for/youtubers): YouTube transcripts to Shorts scripts, threads, and blog posts.
- [LinkedIn ghostwriters](/use-cases/linkedin-ghostwriters): Ghostwrite for executives at scale, brand-voice trained per client.
- [Podcast to social](/use-cases/podcast-to-social): Long-form audio → multi-platform posts in minutes.
- [YouTube to LinkedIn](/use-cases/youtube-to-linkedin): Repurpose YouTube videos for B2B LinkedIn audiences.
- [Content repurposing for agencies](/use-cases/content-repurposing-agencies): Workflow + pricing for client-services teams.

## Free tools (no signup for first use)

- [YouTube to Twitter thread](/tools/youtube-to-twitter-thread): Free thread generator.
- [Blog to LinkedIn carousel](/tools/blog-to-linkedin-carousel): Free carousel generator from any URL.
- [Podcast to newsletter](/tools/podcast-to-newsletter): Audio/transcript → newsletter draft.
- [Newsletter to social](/tools/newsletter-to-social): Email content → tweets and LinkedIn posts.
- [LinkedIn video downloader](/tools/linkedin-video-downloader): Free MP4 download from any public LinkedIn video.
- [AI image generator](/tools/ai-image-generator): Social-ready images via Replicate models.
- [YouTube thumbnail maker](/tools/youtube-thumbnail-maker): AI thumbnails with text overlay.
- [Hook generator](/tools/hook-generator): A/B-test 10 hooks per topic for Twitter and LinkedIn.
- [Reply generator](/tools/reply-generator): On-brand replies for engagement.
- [Podcast transcript generator](/tools/podcast-transcript-generator): Whisper + speaker diarization, chapters, pull-quotes.
- [YouTube to blog](/tools/youtube-to-blog): Convert any YouTube video to a publishable SEO blog post.
- [Blog to newsletter](/tools/blog-to-newsletter): Blog URL → ready-to-send email newsletter.
